FORM 10-Q/A - QUARTERLY REPORT
Filing ID: NWI-10QA-FY2024Q3    Filed: 2025-03-19
For the three months ended September 30, 2024 (fiscal 2024, quarter 3)
(All amounts in thousands of U.S. dollars, unless otherwise stated.)

=== PART I - ITEM 2. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS ===

Revenue for the quarter was 462,100, an increase of 4.3% compared with the prior-year quarter (443,200).
Gross margin was 36.4%, an expansion of 526 basis points versus the prior-year quarter (31.1%).
Operating income was 75,200, representing an operating margin of 16.3%. Net income was 54,300.
Gross margin expanded primarily as a result of the roll-off of the warranty accrual and improved pricing on aftermarket parts.

| Total | 462,100 | 100.0% |

Explanatory note. This Amendment No. 1 on Form 10-Q/A restates our Quarterly Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2024. Revenue was reduced by $4.2 million, cost of goods sold by $2.8 million, and gross profit by $1.4 million. The amounts in this amendment supersede those previously reported.
